name: Proof assistant optimized for reinforcement learning

mentions.name: Proof assistant optimized for reinforcement learning
mentions.description: This project is a new proof assistant designed to be more suitable for reinforcement learning than Lean, featuring faster typechecking and specialized APIs for tree search.
mentions.problem: Existing proof assistants like Lean are less suitable for reinforcement learning, due to slower typechecking and a lack of specialized tree search APIs.
